definition: Understands x q: x actually understands q (intelligere in actu), not merely has the power to (HasIntellect, DEF-HAS-INTELLECT). The object type is a free parameter (things, natures, propositions). Example: a geometer considering the triangle. Counterexample: a human intellect before any act of understanding (q.79 a.2: the possible intellect as a tabula rasa). In Lean a parameter B -> Q -> Prop.
